segments.name: Healthcare-related real estate
segments.description: Provides financing and capital to long-term healthcare operators through leases and real estate loans on healthcare facilities.
segments.evidence: Omega has one reportable segment consisting of investments in healthcare-related real estate properties located in the United States ("U.S."), the United Kingdom ("U.K.") and Canada.

revenueModel.text: Healthcare operators pay Omega rent under long-term leases and interest on real estate loans, mainly for long-term care facilities.
revenueModel.evidence: The reportable segment derives revenues from operators primarily through providing financing and capital to the long-term healthcare industry.
